meta.name: Pluto TV Action
meta.description:
It’s time to go into overdrive by jumping off buildings, flying a burning plane, driving in a car chase and saving the world. Pluto TV Action brings you blockbusters, stars, and a strong dose of high-octane excitement.

Shows: Patriot Games, Clear and Present Danger, The Sum of All Fears, Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit, The Equalizer 2
Available on: Pluto TV
